I have an idea for another page... a shared / collaborative slot machine 
let me explain 
It is very similar to the existing board 
except instead of posting text yourself, 
the message is a random five letter string A-Z0-9
there is a big button you can press and when you do, 
the slot machine animation starts 
the server decides on a random string 
if any three or more characters are the same 
you are a "winner" 
if all five are in ascending or descending order 
you are a "winner" 
you can't press the button until the animation has settled fully 
nobody can press the button until the animation has settled fully 
then the next person who presses it goes next 
but nobody knows who pressed 
there is no sign in or any name associated with any press
but you know if your button press worked 
or not 
all we care about is the messages 
same as before 
we store all previous messages locally 
same island idea as before 
same reconciliation idea as before 
the animation should be beautiful like a slot machine 
but remember no money changes hands, this is all for fun 
once you have successfully pressed the button ten times 
you get a second button 
this second button means you no longer have to press the button manually 
it automatically retries to press the button once the animation has settled 
in the results, 
unlike before, 
we need some kind of visual indication for "winners" 
and we also need to explain in the about page what the "winners" are 
and what the technical aspects of this page are

If only a few files (under five or there about) need to change, give me the full path of the files that need to change and the FULL file 
if there are a lot of files that need to change 
    Delivery
    Whole project as one tar.gz, unambiguous file placement
    Any files to delete on updates called out explicitly
    No bespoke sed/patch scripts — full files only for anything that changes
    Docs updated alongside code changes
    Low verbosity, no code comments
